name: hackathon-kit
description: A small, tiered Claude Code starter set for AI, agent and data hackathons. Core is about 2k tokens always-on; everything else is opt-in.

plugins.name: hackathon-skills
plugins.description: Four skills: model-advisor, session-handoff-maintenance, deepen-task, opt-in-picker. No dependencies, so it also works in Claude Desktop chat and Cowork.

plugins.name: hackathon-core
plugins.description: Core set: hackathon-skills + superpowers + ponytail. Install this first.

plugins.name: hackathon-web
plugins.description: Web projects: frontend-design + Playwright MCP (needs Node.js).

plugins.name: hackathon-data
plugins.description: Data projects: Anthropic's data skills. Its bundled MCP servers need paid accounts; disable them with /mcp if you have none.
